edge_explainer.market_believes: An 8.6% yield at 8.7x earnings means Poland is dangerous or the payout is doomed.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The bank is FAIRLY priced once you tax-normalize (the new bank tax eats the excess yield — that's the masked story, not rates); what's left is ~7.3% net carry plus a merger option where Pekao holds the structural high cards (acquirer role, its own stake handed back, trapped-capital release).
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Almost none today (+0.7pp, inside noise) — and we say so. The option's decisive variable (the exchange ratio) doesn't exist yet; the edge, if any, arrives with a fair ratio print we've pre-committed to act on within days.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It is — 1.75x book vs justified 1.6-1.9x IS the fair range; the market and we agree.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The definitive merger agreement + exchange ratio (targeted end-2026, after enabling legislation + 120-day docs + Council of Ministers + KNF + dual 75% EGMs); interim: AGM dividend, each MPC meeting, the ROE-cap bill's parliamentary track.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Ratio >10% PZU-favorable, OR the ROE-cap bill advancing with coalition support, OR normalized ROE proving <14% at 11% COE — any one converts to REJECT.
edge_explainer.edge_type: fair-carry + structured merger option; ladder entry on user's desk AFTER the lean red team
